title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (inferred from context, not stated on this page): we are in the continuation of 'La Longue Marche', in the genus-1 part of the Teichmüller tower. G_3 is a modular-type group generated by elliptic elements ρ and σ (by analogy with SL2(Z), probably of orders 4 and 6, or 2 and 3 projectively). M is a rank-2 lattice with basis λ0, λ1 and δ = λ1 − λ0. G_{ρ,σ} is an extension of G_3 by M, or a version of it divided by μ.

A splitting of this extension is described by lifts ρ' = ξρ and σ' = ησ, given by (257):
- ξ = a0 λ0 + a1 λ1;
- η = b δ;
- the parameters a0, a1, b are constrained by (250).

There is also a family of automorphisms u_μ, indexed by units μ of Z/12 (the group Φ_12^* = O_12^*). They act on M by multiplication by μ, and they are defined in (150, 151). We write ν = ν(μ) = (μ − 1)/2.

The previous page reduced the centralizer of (ρ', σ') to elements of the form λ u_μ with λ ∈ M. It wrote the condition λ u_μ(ρ') = ρ' as
(261): (1 − ρ)λ + 2νξ + νλ1 = 0.

This page does the same for σ'. One has u_μ(η) = η^μ and u_μ(σ) = σ, because the term ω is killed in G_{ρ,σ}/μ. Hence λ η^μ σ(λ^{-1}) = η, which additively reads
(260): (1 − σ)λ + 2νη = 0.

Writing λ = x λ0 + y λ1, the two vector equations become three scalar equations (262):
- −x + y = −2νb (from 261);
- x + y = −2νa0 (from 260);
- −x + 2y = −ν(2a1 + 1) (from 260).

The page then recalls the constraint (250) on a0, a1, b as (263). Solving the first and third equations gives (264):
- y = ν(−2a1 + 2b − 1);
- x = y + 2νb = ν(−2a1 + 4b − 1).

On the next page, substituting into the second equation gives 2ν(a0 − 2a1 + 3b − 1) = 0. This follows automatically from (263). So for every μ there is exactly one λ, and it depends linearly on ν(μ).

Conclusion (next page): for every splitting (ρ', σ') of the extension over G_3, the assignment μ ↦ λ(μ) u_μ is a homomorphic section Φ_12^* → G^♮_{ρ,σ}. Splittings over Φ_12^* × G_3 therefore correspond to splittings over G_3. In modern terms this is a hands-on computation in H^1 of a modular group with coefficients in a lattice, together with the compatibility of the Galois-type action of (Z/12)^*.
errors: The transcription writes y = −ν(−2a1+2b−1). Correct algebra from (262) gives y = ν(−2a1+2b−1): subtracting the first equation from the third gives y = −ν(2a1+1) + 2νb. The manuscript seems to have the minus sign struck out.

The transcription reads (263) as −2a0+2a1−3b+1 = 0. For the consistency check on the next page (a0−2a1+3b−1 = 0) to follow from it, it must be −a0+2a1−3b+1 = 0. The '2' before a0 appears overwritten or struck in the manuscript.
In the text 'La première et troisième équation (263)' the reference should be (262). This is a slip in the manuscript.

ideas.what: Computing the centralizer of a splitting (ρ', σ') of a lattice extension of a modular-type group inside the extended group. The fixed-point conditions are written as linear equations (1−ρ)λ = …, (1−σ)λ = … in M.
ideas.modern_name: Splittings of M ⋊ SL2(Z)-type extensions; H^1(Γ, M) computed via the elliptic generators
ideas.where_published: Related material appears in La Longue Marche (1981, circulated); this specific computation is unsure

ideas.what: Showing that a splitting over G_3 extends uniquely to a section over Φ_12^* × G_3, i.e. equivariance with respect to the (Z/12)^* 'Galois' automorphisms u_μ.
ideas.modern_name: Extending a splitting compatibly with an outer action of a group of units (Galois-equivariance of the genus-1 Teichmüller tower data)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck's Teichmüller tower programme; later Ihara, Nakamura and others on Galois actions in genus 1
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the tower only in general terms

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine linear-algebra and cocycle verification inside a longer computation. It has minor sign and coefficient slips that self-correct on the next page. It contains no new conceptual idea beyond the general Longue Marche programme.
transcription_corrections: The first equation number is (261), not (259): equation (262) refers to it as '(exprime (261))'.
The symbol in (261) is ξ, from ρ' = ξρ in (257).
In the derivation, u_μ(σ) = ω^{…}σ = σ 'car ω = 1 dans G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G'.
In (264), y = ν(−2a1+2b−1); the leading minus sign is struck out.
In (263) the coefficient of a0 is −1, not −2: read −a0+2a1−3b+1 = 0.
The phrase about a0, a1, b should read roughly: 'où les quantités a0, a1, b figurent multipliées par des facteurs multiplicatifs ν = ν(μ), et satisfont (250)', not 'en dénominateurs'.
'La première et troisième équation (262) se résolvent en x, y': the manuscript reads (262) or (263) ambiguously, but (262) is meant.
